title: Easy Wiggly Text Animation in PROCREATE #Shorts - Quick Procreate Tutorial
description:
Procreate Short Tutorial!
In this short video I will show you how you can easily create a wiggly text animation in Procreate.

Want more short tutorials? Leave a comment!

In this short Procreate tutorial we'll do the following to create a wiggly text animation
✔ Add a text and turn it into an outline (you can turn it on in the text editing menu)
✔ Lower the opacity of the text layer and make a new layer on top
✔ Trace the outline of your text
✔ Turn on animation assist 
✔ Add a new frame and trace the text again
✔ Repeat this multiple times
✔ Remove the original text layer or turn it off
✔ Set the animation speed to 9 frames per second (or any speed you like) and set it to Ping-Pong
✔ Tap play and enjoy your animation!

Now you'll never wonder how to create a wiggly text animation in Procreate again!
